products.name: CSV → Excel-Ready
products.summary: Offline browser UTF-8 BOM / encoding fixer so valid UTF-8 CSV opens more reliably in Excel. Preserves CSV bytes when BOM-only; optional explicit Windows-1252 conversion. Not schema mapping or duplicate detection.

products.name: CSV Column Mapper
products.summary: Offline CSV column mapping / CSV schema mapping via editable JSON map. Renames and reorders columns; no joins, fuzzy matching, AI, or Excel xlsx.

products.name: CSV Duplicate Finder
products.summary: Offline CSV duplicate detection by one column or composite key. Writes unique and duplicates CSVs for review; source file never modified; no fuzzy matching.

products.name: CSV Cleanup Toolkit
products.summary: Discounted package of CSV Column Mapper and CSV Duplicate Finder as two independent CLIs. Individual tools also sold at £5 each (total £10); toolkit is not exclusive.

products.name: RFQ → Catalogue Matcher
products.summary: Offline RFQ catalogue matching: plain-text RFQ lines against a JSON catalogue with MATCHED / AMBIGUOUS / UNMATCHED statuses. Not OCR, PDF, ML, or ERP.

products.name: RPG Maker Case-Sensitive Asset Auditor
products.price_note: Minimum £3 (flexible / NWYW on itch); not a fixed £3 price.
products.summary: Local Chromium HTML tool that audits case-sensitive RPG Maker MV/MZ asset references. Read-only; no auto-fix; folder picker browsers only.

products.name: URL Audit Report
